answer: Because the ocean release is logged with every signature, the glacier audit reveals the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the jade graph and each risks its bond. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 6 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 5 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
